_u1_rescope.question: U-1 — is a hosted LLM judge feasible for this project?
_u1_rescope.outcome_text: Re-scope. Evaluation is deterministic scorers only. The calibrated-judge claim is formally withdrawn: faithfulness, answer relevance and context precision are not reported as headline metrics, and no Cohen's kappa is published.
reasons: No paid API credentials are available and no API spend will be incurred; this is a standing constraint, not a queue.
ADR-0008 serves retrieved evidence rather than generated prose, so faithfulness has no subject: with no generated claim the metric is undefined, not 1.0.
_u1_rescope.local_judge: Declined. Permitted by EVAL_PROTOCOL 4.1(b) and feasible on the verified CPU stack, but it would have no generated text to evaluate.
reopen_requires: a generator exists in the request path

_verification_procedure: Set OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then run the §10.2 procedure: list live models, pick the current ID (or the documented successor), make one minimal call per role (1 token in, <=16 out), save the response to docs/setup/model-smoke/<role>.json, and write the returned response id into verified_by.

judge_strong.note: Must be cross-provider relative to the generator under test (skill rag-eval-protocol).

judge_fast.note: ci_approved may only become true after >=0.8 agreement with the strong judge AND human labels on 60-100 double-labeled items.

embeddings_local.rationale: Pinned by ADR-0002 after a five-arm bake-off on the real RBI/SEBI corpus (149 chunks, 21 docs) against all-MiniLM-L6-v2, bge-base-en-v1.5 (768 d), multilingual-e5-small and a BM25 lexical control. No candidate was significantly better (paired bootstrap + exact McNemar, all p >= 0.42, every 95% CI straddling zero). Chosen on structural grounds instead: 0/149 chunks truncated at its 512-token limit where MiniLM truncated 72/149 at 256, smallest index at 384 d (1544 B/vector), 128.3 MB on disk, CPU-only and free. Supersedes the earlier MTEB-leaderboard rationale, which was never measured on this corpus.

reranker_local.threshold_check: PASS — 4.56 ms/pair is well under the 50 ms/pair limit in §10.2, so the heavier BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 remains a viable build-phase A/B arm rather than being ruled out on latency.
reranker_local.rationale: Fast, CPU-friendly, well-established baseline cross-encoder. Quality A/B against bge-reranker-v2-m3 is a build-phase ADR.
